scope: current tracked historical LFS pointer claims and verified repair state

sourceAudits.evidence: The supplied GAME workspace contains no GLB, TIF, TIFF, GPKG, KTX2, BLEND, WAV, or FLAC files.
Both available exports contain only 129-133 byte LFS pointer text for the relevant paths.
The connected owner folder is a raster concept-art recovery source and contains no candidate payload types for these claims.

The pinned bridge-runtime generator reproduced all 96 runtime GLBs, the canonical primitive-scene catalogue reproduced all 24 representative seed GLBs, and the pinned GIS generator reproduced all five world-generation sources byte-for-byte. Every payload matched its tracked SHA-256 and byte count before Git LFS cached it.
The preceding authenticated remote audit returned not-found responses for all current object claims.

policy.exactRestoration: Copy a candidate into LFS storage only after its complete bytes hash to the declared oidSha256 and its length equals bytes.
policy.mismatchHandling: Never relabel or fabricate an object. Keep the historical pointer claim, publish any rebuilt payload under a new versioned path and OID, and update active catalog references forward.
policy.claimRetention: Do not delete unresolved claims or rewrite Git history.
